item.title: Cells move 1/43: kernel moves into packages/kernel behind shims
item.criterion: Cells move 1 of 43 (RFC 0006; plan entry 1 in bin/cells-plan.json): the 6 paths the entry lists for package kernel move with git mv to their planned targets under packages/kernel, and packages/kernel/index.js is the front door, re-exporting the 5 modules other code imports. Each of those old paths keeps a re-export shim; nothing else outside the cell changes except path-map.json and the cell lint baseline. The cell lint counts change as the entry states (legacySource 0, shims +5, boundaries +4) and none rises; node bin/cells-plan.js --moved kernel passes, and the full suite passes on Node 22.13 and 24.
